quotes.text:
For folders with special folder flags and specific English names, Thunderbird
now uses localized strings in order to respect the application's locale.

There is potential for visual folders duplication if multiple folders have the
same folder Flag and name.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted ADR 0004 records localized display names for special folders with matching flags and specific English names, plus mail.useLocalizedFolderNames as an opt-out. It explicitly preserves duplicate-looking folders and differences from server labels as risks. The fixed accepted document retains this decision. This is scoped architecture-document evidence; the separate getter-boundary lesson records Inbox, AllMail and local-folder exceptions, and the ADR does not prove all providers' behavior or a running release.
title: ADR 0004 records the folder-name preference and its display risks
